title: Dutch Stew with Jagged Peas
description: A hearty Dutch stew recipe featuring jagged peas and a tangy mustard flavor. Perfect for a cold winter night.

ingredients.name: jagged
ingredients.notes: Choose jagged peas for this recipe

ingredients.name: mustardy mustard
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality mustard for the best flavor

ingredients.name: dutch stew beef
ingredients.notes: Optional, omit for a vegetarian version

ingredients.name: stew
ingredients.notes: Use a good-quality stew broth for this recipe

instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the Dutch stew beef (if using) and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the mustardy mustard and cook for another minute.
Add the jagged peas, stew, and enough water to cover the ingredients.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the peas and cook for another 5 minutes, or until they are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
